Robot — Central Asia

Bolt.m3 · 2023–2024 season · Almaty, Kazakhstan

The first full build of the mecanum platform — the version that proved 8 motors could fit in a 40×32×32 frame using a belt-and-gear-ratio system, making it the only CIS team to run that configuration. This chassis is where the drivetrain philosophy that carried through to Worlds was worked out.

2025 NEW ENGLAND PREMIER EVENT, USA

Robot — New York

Bolt.m3 · 2024–2025 season · Gold, Connect Award

The refined build taken to the premier event. Two one-wheel GoBilda odometers paired with an Adafruit BNO005 IMU through the REV hub gave precise field-centric drive on the mecanum base. Tele-op and autonomous were coded in Android Studio, with the Road Runner library handling the autonomous routines and every drive input running through a single joystick mapping.

PRODUCT 01
LORA GPS LIVESTOCK TRACKER

GPS Tracker

JAS Technology · $0 starting budget · Almaty, Kazakhstan

In this CAD, I used four main components plus a 5V Li-ion battery for power. Here's a breakdown of each part and what it does.

01

ATMEGA328P

The main brain of the circuit, powered at 5V.

02

HM10

Converts the signal to Bluetooth, so the tracker can pair directly with a phone.

03

CPA — Ceramic Patch Antenna

Acts as a local satellite receiver, picking up GPS position data.

04

LoRa Transceiver

Sends signals up to 10km, giving the tracker long range without a cellular network.

05

5V Li-Ion Battery

Powers the whole board.

Together, these four components and the battery match perfectly — built from a $0 starting budget and sold and donated across Kazakhstan and rural China.
PRODUCT 02
SMART DRIP-IRRIGATION CONTROLLER

Plant Safer

JAS Technology · 50+ units sold · Almaty, Kazakhstan

Designed and built an IoT-based smart irrigation system using an ESP8266 as the controller, a soil humidity sensor to monitor moisture levels, a relay to switch the water pump, and a Blynk interface for real-time monitoring and remote smartphone control.

🌱 01

ESP8266 Controller

The brain of Plant Safer — runs the irrigation logic and Wi-Fi connection to Blynk.

🌱 02

Soil Humidity Sensor

Wiring passes through these side ports to monitor soil moisture levels.

🌱 03

Relay

Switches the water pump on and off automatically, based on the sensor reading.

🌱 04

Weatherproof Port Caps

Swappable covers keep the sensor and pump connectors sealed against water and dust.

🌱 Part of the same drip-irrigation line JAS Technology sold to over 50 farmers across Kazakhstan — monitored and controlled remotely through the Blynk app.
MOBILE INTERFACE

Blynk App

This is the Blynk dashboard for Plant Safer — it shows the live soil moisture reading and lets you switch the water pump on or off directly from your phone, from anywhere.

KNOWN LIMITATIONS
  • Needs a Wi-Fi connection to work.
  • Because it relies on Arduino's humidity sensor, the reading isn't fully precise — there's roughly a 12–17% margin of error.
  • Ideally the pump would auto-trigger when humidity drops low; I tried to implement that, but couldn't get it working reliably enough.

TECH 120 — PURDUE DESIGN & INNOVATION COMPETITION

The extrusion drivetrain

The mechanical core of the filament extrusion system — a REV motor driving a worm-gear reducer into the spool, framed by CNC-cut aluminum plates. Built and tested as a working prototype alongside an ESP32, hot-end, relay, and 24V supply.

ROLE
Team Lead
TEAM
5 people
RESULT
Top 10 / ~680 students
DRIVE ASSEMBLY
MECHANICAL DRIVETRAIN

Motor, Gearbox & Spool

TECH 120 · Purdue · 2026

Built and tested a working prototype using an ESP32, a REV motor, a hot-end, a relay, and a 24V power supply. This render is the mechanical half of that system — the drivetrain that turns motor torque into filament feed.

01

REV Motor + Gearbox

A REV motor through a worm-gear reducer drives the spool — shown here exploded for clarity.

02

Drive Spool

Wraps and feeds the filament as it winds through the extrusion path.

03

REV Motor, Output Side

Mounted through the opposite plate, delivering torque straight to the spool shaft.

04

Aluminum Frame Plates

CNC-cut side plates hold the shaft and motor mounts, keeping the drivetrain aligned.

Selected as one of five team leads across the course and placed Top 10 among ~680 TECH 120 students across all sections.

AI machine safety monitor

An AI-powered machine safety system that uses a camera to detect people near dangerous machinery. It gives visual and audio warnings as they approach, helping prevent workplace injuries and improve manufacturing safety.

STACK
YOLO, Python, HTML/CSS
DETECTION
4-stage danger zone
STATUS
In progress
PROTOTYPE
DANGER ZONE DETECTION

Camera-Based Safety Monitor

Personal project · 2026 · in progress

Below is a working desktop prototype: a webcam feed tracks a person's hand relative to a machine's blade, splitting the space into concentric safety rings. As the hand crosses each ring, the system updates its status and beeps accordingly — quiet when safe, more urgent the closer it gets.

YOLO Python OpenCV HTML/CSS
PROTOTYPE — LIVE DESKTOP DEMO 2026
NEXT STEPS
  • Connect this code to an ESP32-CAM, so it can run as a standalone embedded device instead of a full computer.
  • Design a 3D-printed enclosure for that device — housing the camera, a power supply, and a relay to actually cut power to the machine when someone gets too close.
